title: Lightning
body:
Syntax: (no command of its own -- a personal trait revealed by channeling a Chakra Paper, see 'help channel')

Description: One of the five chakra natures (see 'help elements'). Lightning Strike Jutsu (Ninjutsu, level 20) requires Lightning to cast at all, and carries a real (if rarer) chance to Paralyze the target -- completely unable to act for their next couple of rounds.

Boosted in the mountains. Weakened in swamps.

Date: 2026-08-26

Second nature choices at level 25:
Lightning + Fire: Flashfire Release (help flashfire release)
Lightning + Water: Storm Release (help storm release)
Lightning + Wind: Tempest Release (help tempest release)
Lightning + Earth: Explosion Release (help explosion release)
